name: interactive-map-builder
tagline_zh: 把Excel坐标变成能搜能筛的交互地图，单文件HTML直接发，还能出论文级SVG/PDF，连不会代码的甲方都能自己。
tagline_en: Turn Excel coords into a searchable, filterable map—single HTML file, paper-ready SVG/PDF, even non-coders can.
desc_en: Turn existing spatial or coordinate data into portable, browser-openable interactive map files and report-ready figures. Use when the user wants parcels, buildings, facilities, parking, roads, water, green space, projects, or Excel/CSV coordinates presented as a searchable, filterable, sortable map, map-and-list page, multilayer planning map, single-file HTML, slide image, or paper SVG/PDF—even wh
why_zh: 同类工具要么只能出静态图，要么要部署服务器。它直接产出单文件HTML，双击即用，还带图层和筛选。
why_en: Unlike static-only tools or server-dependent apps, it outputs a self-contained HTML with layers and filters—double-click to use.
